{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers only
loyal_customers = sales_df[sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Calculate the number of loyal customers who converted
num_converted = loyal_customers['converted'].sum()

# Calculate the total number of loyal customers
total_loyal = len(loyal_customers)

# Calculate the fraction converted
fraction_converted = num_converted / total_loyal

num_converted, total_loyal, fraction_converted"}
